example.title: Oceanside Civic Center, 300 North Coast Highway (Charles Moore / Moore Ruble Yudell, 1990)

brief: The 1990 civic centre of a pier town, designed as a homage to Irving Gill's 1934 city hall next door: two- and three-storey white stucco blocks with plain punched windows, deep round-arched loggias and arcades, a tall arched entrance with blue-painted frames and glass-block panels, patterned tile inlays in red, yellow and blue, a courtyard of shallow reflecting pools and rows of tall palms, and a gateway of stylised red-and-gold palm columns. The city seal and 'City Hall' lettering on the wall. Five photos. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
label: Town Hall
